title: The Pen Still Has Work
scope: Editorial approval of revised post copy after the independent 8.34 caption score. Same-scorer regrade is required on this new SHA; this editor does not substitute a numerical pass.

authority.override: Dispatch uses 900 to 2200 characters and 3 to 5 ending hashtags. The legacy weekly word band, no-hashtag rule, weekly structure and separate quotable-headline block do not apply to post.txt.

line_edits.original: A gathered report and an editable first draft are concrete preparation outputs. Give that work its credit. Then follow what happens to it. Looking through a report to make a determination is a different action from refining generated prose. Neither disappears just because a page has arrived.
line_edits.suggested: A gathered report and an editable draft deserve credit as real preparation. Judge a finished workflow by the professional decision that follows, not by the arrival of a page.
line_edits.reason: Condense the preparation-credit position into two evaluative sentences and move it immediately below the hook, before KGS background.

line_edits.reason: Split the DORA mechanism at the input-to-retrieval boundary so source/tool/input and retrieval/logic/decision scan separately.

line_edits.original: Follow the report. Follow the draft. After the output arrives, which part of the work is still yours?
line_edits.suggested: What would you check in an assembled report, or change in a generated draft, before putting it to work?
line_edits.reason: Ask for a concrete report check or draft change, giving readers a specific professional action to describe.

claim_review.reason: A separate paragraph names LLMs and Amazon Bedrock, initial document sections, and people refining and approving. No first draft is presented as a final contract or award.

claim_review.subject: Earned preparation credit and limits
claim_review.reason: The argument credits the gathered report and editable draft, then distinguishes review from refinement. It explicitly declines independent Wingman productivity proof and scopes unquantified Alaska return to the announcement. It makes no claim of no benefit.

claim_review.subject: Optional numeric claims
claim_review.reason: No task-duration, cost-avoidance or portfolio-hours figure appears. The only numeric date is the approved September 11th announcement.
